facts.business: Baba Arts Limited is engaged in the business of trading of Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) and related activities in the media and entertainment sector.
key_risks: Contingent liability relating to demand of service tax pending before CESTAT
Lower profit margin on trading of IPR
Change in management and control of the company
facts.related_party_note: The erstwhile sole Promoter of the Company, Mr. Gordhan P. Tanwani, entered into a Share Purchase Agreement dated 25th February, 2026 with Skybridge Interactive LLP for the sale of 3,92,00,000 equity shares aggregating 74.67% of the paid-up equity share capital, together with transfer of control and management.
